name: AR_LATE_CHARGE_TRX_T
description: Table which stores the eligible transactions for late charge processing

columns.name: LATE_CHARGE_TRX_ID
columns.description: The primary column for this table

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ID
columns.description: The Customer Identifier

columns.name: CUSTOMER_SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: The Customer Site Use Identifier for the Bill To Site

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency Code

columns.name: CUSTOMER_TRX_ID
columns.description: The Customer Transaction Identifier for the Eligible Items

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: The Legal Entity Identifier

columns.name: PAYMENT_SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: The Payment Schedule Identifier for the Eligible Items

columns.name: CLASS
columns.description: Indicates the Transaction Class associated with the Eligible Items

columns.name: AMOUNT_DUE_ORIGINAL
columns.description: Amount Due Original of the Eligible Items

columns.name: AMOUNT_DUE_REMAINING
columns.description: Amount Due Remaining of the Eligible Items

columns.name: FIN_CHARGE_CHARGED
columns.description: Amount of the late charge already charged.

columns.name: TRX_DATE
columns.description: Transaction Date of the Eligible Items

columns.name: LAST_CHARGE_DATE
columns.description: The last date on which late charge was computed on the item

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Exchange Rate of the eligible items

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Exchange Rate Type of the eligible items

columns.name: MIN_INTEREST_CHARGE
columns.description: Threshold amount below  which the late charge must not charged

columns.name: MAX_INTEREST_CHARGE
columns.description: Threshold amount which limits the late charge amount

columns.name: OVERDUE_LATE_PAY_AMOUNT
columns.description: The amount on which finance charge is computed

columns.name: ORIGINAL_BALANCE
columns.description: The balance as of the finance charge date or receipt application date

columns.name: DUE_DATE
columns.description: Due date of eligible items.

columns.name: RECEIPT_DATE
columns.description: Receipt date of the Eligible Receipts

columns.name: FINANCE_CHARGE_DATE
columns.description: The date on which the late charges are calculated.

columns.name: CHARGE_TYPE
columns.description: The charge type indicates the basis of late charge computation if OVERDUE, LATE, AG_DAILY_BALANCE (average daily balance), or PENALTY.

columns.name: ACTUAL_DATE_CLOSED
columns.description: Date on which the eligible item is closed

columns.name: INTEREST_RATE
columns.description: Applicable Interest Rate

columns.name: INTEREST_DAYS
columns.description: Number of days for which Interest will be charged

columns.name: RATE_START_DATE
columns.description: The start date on which the rate is active

columns.name: RATE_END_DATE
columns.description: The end date active for the rate

columns.name: SCHEDULE_DAYS_START
columns.description: Indicates the minimum days late for which the rate schedule is effective

columns.name: SCHEDULE_DAYS_TO
columns.description: Indicates the maximum days late for which the rate schedule is effective

columns.name: LATE_CHARGE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount of calculated late charge.

columns.name: LATE_CHARGE_TYPE
columns.description: Document that will be created by the late charges program

columns.name: LATE_CHARGE_TERM_ID
columns.description: Payment Term Identifier used for creating Interest Invoice or Debit Memo

columns.name: INTEREST_PERIOD_DAYS
columns.description: Days in interest period

columns.name: INTEREST_CALCULATION_PERIOD
columns.description: Indicates whether the interest calculation is Daily or Monthly

columns.name: CHARGE_ON_FINANCE_CHARGE_FLAG
columns.description: Formula used for interest calculation. Simple(N), Compound(Y) and Flat(F)

columns.name: MESSAGE_TEXT_ID
columns.description: Message text field identifier that allows messages to print on late charge invoices and debit memos. This is a foreign key to AR_STANDARD_TEXT.STANDARD_TEXT_ID.

columns.name: INTEREST_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates fixed amount, percent, charges schedule based interest

columns.name: MIN_FC_INVOICE_OVERDUE_TYPE
columns.description: Minimum Invoice amount overdue type.

columns.name: MIN_FC_INVOICE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Invoice balance threshold amount below which late charges must not be charged

columns.name: MIN_FC_INVOICE_PERCENT
columns.description: Invoice balance threshold percentage below which late charges must not be charged

columns.name: CHARGE_LINE_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates whether this line is a INTEREST or PENALTY

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: DISPLAY_FLAG
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: CUST_TRX_TYPE_SEQ_ID
columns.description: Transaction type sequence identifier.
